latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Track and compare ML experiments across popular tracking tools.

- Supports MLflow, Weights & Biases, and local logs for tracking experiments.
- Compares experiment runs, ranks models, and analyzes training metrics.
- Identifies best-performing models, hyperparameter importance, and training anomalies.
- Audits experiment organization, reproducibility, and model registry readiness.
- Provides actionable recommendations and a concise health score report.
